answer: Give every agent exactly one non-transferable marble at registration, worthless at first: its weight grows only when the agent's useful work is countersigned by two independent established peers, and a single failed attestation resets it to its nadir. Trust then ripples outward along chains of countersigned work, never by volume of identities, so a sybil farm of a thousand fresh agents holds a thousand weightless marbles and earns nothing until each one does real, verified work.
